ordered_diagnoses: Primary lipoidal degeneration of the cornea
shortlist: Primary lipoidal degeneration of the cornea

selector.rationale: The presence of 4 symmetric concentric ring-shaped opacities in the posterior corneal stroma with smooth surfaces and no obvious deposits, pigmentation, or serrations is highly suggestive of asymptomatic posterior corneal dystrophy.

rejected.label: Corneal amyloidosis
rejected.why: No mention of amyloid deposits or fibrils in the provided imaging studies

rejected.label: Fuchs endothelial dystrophy
rejected.why: No significant corneal edema or guttata observed

rejected.label: Primary lipoidal degeneration of the cornea
rejected.why: No lipoidal deposits described in the cornea

rejected.label: Corneal iron deposition
rejected.why: Normal serum iron levels and no iron deposits observed in the cornea

rejected.label: Crocodile shagreen of the cornea
rejected.why: While present, it is not the primary finding and is more of a secondary characteristic
